name: 八聲杜鵑
illustrationTaxon: Cacomantis merulinus adult male/typical gray morph: gray hood, brown mantle and wings, plain orange-buff underparts, long graduated tail with pale underside tips

similarSpecies.distinction: 褐翅鴉鵑體型大得多、黑身栗翼、尾長厚重；八聲杜鵑只有18–23 cm，灰頭、褐背及橙腹，身形纖細。
紅翅鳳頭鵑大得多，具尖長黑冠、白色後頸環及栗紅翼；八聲杜鵑無冠、灰頭，橙腹，翅褐且較素。

featureNotes: 成鳥頭及上胸呈灰色，眼紅褐
下體橙淡褐色，成鳥羽面平滑無斑
尾長而漸層，尾下羽端白色

rangeMap.note: Partial country-level overview of the South/Southeast Asian native range. In Hong Kong the species uses lowland rural mosaics, farmland, fishponds, marsh edges, lightly wooded areas and sometimes parks; it occurs year-round with summer visitors and passage migrants. Green countries are not entirely occupied; this is not a precise range polygon or Hong Kong occurrence map.

sources.use: Full HKBWS Plaintive Cuckoo account read: locally fairly common summer visitor, scarce passage and winter visitor, some likely resident. 18–23 cm; adult gray hood to upper breast, gray-brown mantle/wings/tail, unmarked orange-buff underparts; long graduated tail with pale underside tips; reddish iris, black bill with yellow base, yellow legs. Uses lowland rural mixed landscapes and agricultural areas; HKBWS reports IUCN LC/stable.
Cornell eBird/Merlin account read: small/slender, male and typical female orange belly, gray head, brown back/tail; open woods, edges and agriculture; contrasted with rufous hepatic morph.
HKBWS Greater Coucal account previously read for 0076; used for larger dark coucal comparison.
HKBWS Chestnut-winged Cuckoo account read for 0078; used for crest/white-collar/size comparison.
